Headline: #94 California buses Temporary Northbound Reroute near California/Marquette
ShortDescription: Northbound #94 California buses are temporarily rerouted, due to construction near California/Marquette.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #94 California buses are temporarily rerouted via California, 67th, Kedzie, 63rd, California and over regular route, due to construction near California/Marquette.

Southbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Red and Purple Line Delays
ShortDescription: Red and Purple Line trains are running w/major delays following earlier track switching problems at Howard. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red and Purple Line trains are running w/major delays following earlier track switching problems at Howard.

Normal boarding/exiting for Purple Line service has been restored. 

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
